items.title: Lawrence Cotton Interview, 1996-12-10
items.q: We made a record, man, and I never did. We made a party record. ... Hang Down Your Head, Tom Dooley.

For who? I don't know. I don't remember. I remember we made a party record, man. It was very, and it had a sitcom thing on it, a comedy thing about it.
